During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the corporation [[The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania|Adascorp]] used an '''orbital control station''' in the [[Omonoth system/Legends|Omonoth system]], in an attempt to control [[Exogorth/Legends|exogorths]].
